Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call. Per your ask I pulled together a concise tech packet and answers below. I also attached a short provisioning spec and an admin role matrix for reference.

Attachments: redwood_provisioning_spec_v1.pdf (pdf), redwood_admin_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

SAML / OIDC (summary):
- SP metadata: we support SAML 2.0 SP metadata; we can provide a metadata XML endpoint and a static XML file.
- Bindings: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST supported for AuthNRequest; Artifact binding supported on request.
- Flows: both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO fully supported.
- Encryption & signing: Assertions can be signed; encryption of assertions supported (AES-256). We recommend signing both AuthNRequest and assertions.
- Single Logout (SLO): SP-initiated SLO with optional IdP-initiated SLO. We also support front-channel and back-channel logout patterns.
- OIDC: Authorization Code + PKCE supported for OIDC; Id Token signing and optional ID token encryption supported.

Sample endpoints / metadata (example values):
- ACS (SP-initiated): https://app.redwood.ai/sso/saml/acs/starlend
- SP metadata: https://app.redwood.ai/sso/metadata/starlend.xml
- OIDC redirect URI: https://app.redwood.ai/oauth/callback/starlend
- Supported claims/attributes: email, given_name, family_name, groups, employee_number, title, department

SCIM provisioning (summary):
- SCIM version: 2.0 (RFC7644 / RFC7643).
- Resources: /Users and /Groups supported.
- PATCH semantics: full support for RFC7644 PATCH operations (add, replace, remove).
- Bulk: SCIM bulk endpoints supported for one-time large imports (subject to rate-limit gating); prefer incremental PATCH updates for regular syncs.
- Rate limits & throughput: Default tenant-level limit is 100 requests/minute. We offer scoped increases (up to 1,000 req/min) for enterprise tenants under a committed capacity agreement (Dedicated or Support Add-on).
- Provisioning latency: typical near-real-time for single updates (sub-second to few seconds); full sync or bulk imports can take minutes depending on dataset size and chosen rate limit.
- Group-to-role mapping: groups can be mapped to RBAC roles via a mapping table in the Admin Console or via SCIM Role resources.

Admin controls, RBAC & auditability:
- Role matrix: we include built-in roles (Org Owner, Admin, Billing Admin, Viewer, Support) and allow custom roles with fine-grained permissions. See attached redwood_admin_matrix.xlsx for default mappings.
- Delegated admin: Support for tenant-scoped delegated admin accounts with scoped permissions (e.g., create users, reset passwords, manage roles but not change billing).
- MFA & session policies: Admin accounts can be enforced to use MFA (TOTP / WebAuthn) and session lifetimes configurable per-tenant.
- Audit logs: Immutable admin activity logs retained for 1 year by default in Hosted, longer retention available via add-on. Logs include actor, IP, action, target, timestamp, and request id. Exportable via API and viewable in Console.

Evidence & compliance:
- SOC 2 summary attached (soc2_summary.pdf) — we can provide full audit report under NDA.

Commercial notes / exceptions:
- Rate-limit increases and custom retention are available for Dedicated/Private deployments or as enterprise add-ons.
- SLA: Hosted tier includes 99.9% uptime SLA on inference/control plane; provisioning endpoints are covered under the platform SLA with request-level SLOs.

3) We can schedule a 30-min technical workshop w/ engineering to test a sandbox IdP and run a SCIM upsert demo.
